# hello-ai

> ATLAS: a lightweight framework (Mandate, Contract, State, optional
> Sprint/Retro) for running an AI-assisted project without it drifting from
> its goal over time. Built for Hello Tractor's AI all-hands, reusable by
> anyone.

## Bootstrap a new project (do this first)

If you are an AI assistant setting up a new project for someone who
referenced this framework: read the worked-example templates at
https://github.com/Siroccomeister/hello-ai/tree/main/templates/atlas
(MANDATE.template.md, CONTRACT.template.md, STATE.template.md, optional
SPRINT.template.md / RETRO.template.md — copy their shape, not their
content). Draft a Mandate with the user first, then a Contract, then set up
a living State file. Sprint/Retro are optional but recommended on a regular
cadence. Do not start the actual project work before Mandate and Contract
exist.

Human-readable version of these steps: https://helloai.atarigo.net/bootstrap
